transcript.content: Hi, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I keep cutting people off and jumping into their conversations at work, even when I tell myself to stop—I feel like I’m constantly intruding on others. It’s starting to really strain my relationships with my colleagues, and I'm honestly worried about my job.

Besides interrupting people, do you often feel restless and have trouble focusing or waiting your turn in many situations since childhood, or is this mostly happening when you’re very anxious and worrying a lot?

This has actually been going on since I was a kid, long before any work anxiety. Even in elementary school, my teachers wrote on my report cards that I was too restless, always tapping my desk and unable to stay in my seat. The urge to move has always been there, but my new coaching role has just made it a much bigger problem lately.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient reports a longstanding pattern since childhood of hyperactivity/impulsivity, including interrupting others, intruding into conversations, restlessness, tapping, and difficulty remaining seated. Symptoms were present well before current work-related anxiety and are now causing occupational and interpersonal impairment, supporting ADHD, predominantly hyperactive-impulsive type.
